skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply research methodologies and analyze data to solve practical problems in public management and organizations.
Identify and solve real-world problems related to public management and organizations.
Effectively communicate research findings and solutions through presentations and reports.
Manage time and resources effectively to complete research projects.
Understand and apply principles of public management and organizational management.
Analyze and propose solutions for public policies and organizational issues.
Develop strategic plans and policies for public organizations.
Demonstrate ethical behavior and leadership qualities in public management roles.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve complex problems in public management.
Work independently and take responsibility for professional tasks.

prerequisite_courses: All required courses of the Public Management major
